The light still needed tending, and so, it turned out, did this.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市从未真正睡去。便利店的灯光如孤岛般漂浮在黑暗街道上，收银员独自对着监控摄像头打哈欠。环卫工人推着橙色的车，刷子划过柏油路面发出沙沙声响，那声音在空旷的街道里传得很远。偶尔一辆出租车驶过，车灯扫亮湿漉漉的路面，又迅速消失在拐角。高楼上只有零星几扇窗还亮着——加班的程序员、失眠的老人、或是刚哭完的人。这城市在这一刻像是脱掉了白天的伪装，露出它疲倦而真实的面目。连风都轻了，只是轻轻拂过梧桐树叶，像是怕吵醒什么。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by first solving a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding it defined using another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive solution needs a stopping point, called the base case, so it does not keep going forever — like knowing when you finally reach a word simple enough to understand without looking anything else up.\n• Computers use recursion all the time for things like exploring folders inside folders, or finding paths through mazes, because it lets them repeat a process without you having to spell out every single step."}
